title: AI-assisted layout, LibreSprite edits: feedback on my next game's art style?
author: FinunStudios
selftext:
I'm exploring the visual direction for my next game, and this boat workshop is an early interior sample. I'd like to get some honest feedback before making more environments in this style.

For this image, I used AI only to sketch the building's floor plan and the placement of objects. I then retouched the artwork in LibreSprite.

Does the muted, rustic palette work for you, or does the scene feel too flat or hard to read? Do the characters stand out enough from the wooden floor and props? Is it clear which objects might be interactive?

What would you change first: lighting, contrast, colors, or the amount of detail? I'd love to hear what you'd keep, too.

https://i.redd.it/3opisub5ouxh1.png

comments.author: FrankenChocula
comments.body: I like it, apart from the little yellow tick marks or whatever they are all over the image.  That adds a very busy look and isn't appealing.

replies.author: FinunStudios
replies.body: Thank you, I'm going to delete it then; your observation is very accurate.
